# NAMI Creative

> NAMI Creative is a Newcastle and North East marketing partner and creative network run by Joe Wilson. NAMI helps local businesses, brands, freelancers, artists, musicians, makers, and creatives get seen through clearer marketing, better websites, stronger content, practical automation, and the NAMI Creative Network.

Founder: Joe Wilson
Location: Newcastle upon Tyne and Jarrow, North East England, United Kingdom
Audience served: North East businesses, Newcastle creatives, freelancers, artists, musicians, makers, independent brands, and small business owners
Primary region: Newcastle upon Tyne, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham, Northumberland, Tyne and Wear, North East England

## What NAMI does

NAMI Creative has two connected parts.

1. **Marketing and creative support for businesses**
   - Brand positioning and messaging
   - Website strategy, design, and development
   - Content strategy and creative direction
   - Buyer journey and lead flow improvements
   - Automation, CRM, reporting, and workflow support

2. **NAMI Creative Network**
   - A growing network for North East creatives, artists, freelancers, musicians, photographers, designers, makers, local businesses, and independent brands
   - Helps local people get seen through NAMI features, roundups, referrals, showcase opportunities, future events, and community spaces
   - Built around supporting North East creativity and making good local work easier to discover

## Core positioning

NAMI Creative helps North East businesses and creatives make waves of creative impact. The marketing services and Creative Network work together around one goal: support the North East, help good people get seen, and make the work easier to act on.

NAMI is Joe-led, personal, practical, and local. It is not positioned as a large agency. It is a hands-on partner for people who need clearer marketing, better content, a stronger website, smoother workflows, or a community around their creative work.

## Services

- **Brand positioning and identity support**: clearer message, tone, offer, and visual direction
- **Content strategy and creation**: content pillars, formats, campaign direction, and repeatable workflows
- **Website and buyer journey support**: website structure, copy, design, development, and paths to enquiry
- **Creative direction**: visual language, campaign ideas, content direction, and brand consistency
- **Automation and workflow support**: CRM, lead capture, follow-up, reporting, dashboards, and practical systems that save time

## NAMI Creative Network

The network exists for North East creatives, artists, musicians, photographers, designers, makers, freelancers, local businesses, and independent brands. Joining helps NAMI understand who is building what, where they are based, and how they might be featured, recommended, referred, or included in future roundups and opportunities.

Network page: https://namicreative.co.uk/network
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/namicreativeuk/

## Selected work

- **Whittaker Property Group**: content strategy, website development, automation and lead flow, CRM development, paid social management
- **The League**: positioning, identity, website, invitation flow, and lifecycle email for a UK members club
- **VESSL**: website and conversion funnel for a fitness brand
- **MILLIONS**: on-chain intelligence brand, dashboard, and alerting infrastructure
- **Energy Consultants Association**: trade body brand, website, member communications, and campaign support
- **Barking Puppy**: community brand and creative support
